thread:
Priya (AE): Hey team — AtlasBank POC hit us with a slow TTFT report this morning and also asked for pricing for Dedicated + answers for their security questionnaire. Can we swarm?

Riya (SE): on it. Can you paste the failing request id / sample payload? Customer says >15s first token for short prompts (<= 30 tokens).

Priya (AE): request id 9f1b2c, snippet: `POST /v1/generate model: redwood-medium prompt: \"Summarize tx\"` — they saw 15-22s. No 429s yet but they mentioned intermittent 503s yesterday.

Jordan (SRE): grabbing logs and current node metrics. Looks like two nodes handling AtlasBank traffic; both show high batch sizes ~64 during their spike window (we cap at 128). I see KV cache misses — prefix cache hit rate ~12% for that customer.

Riya (SE): KV miss 12% is rough. Are they using session pinning or arbitrary connection ids? If sessions rotate, warmup won't help.

Priya (AE): AtlasBank says they create a new conversation id per user request for security reasons. They asked if that forces cold starts.

Marta (Solutions Eng): yes, new convo ids => no prefix reuse. We should recommend token-preserving warmup or prefetching common system prompts. Also suggest a small per-session warmup: send a short 1-token prompt to prime KV cache.

Jordan (SRE): Confirmed; adding an excerpt from the runtime logs around request 9f1b2c:

```
[2026-03-10T09:12:03Z] req=9f1b2c shard=us-west-2 node=gw-7 latency=21000ms batching=64 kv_hit=false cold_started=true
[2026-03-10T09:12:03Z] trace: compile_path select=fp16_kernel_v2 queue_wait=80ms
[2026-03-10T09:12:03Z] gpu0: load=78% gpu1: load=81% prefetched_prefix=null
```

Jordan (SRE): The long latency is mostly queue_wait + model exec due to large batch and cache miss. When kv_hit=false, we re-run some expensive prep.

Riya (SE): Two immediate mitigations: 1) Ask Atlas devs to reuse conversation ids where safe OR send a tiny warmup request on session create. 2) We can add a per-customer warmup profile on Dedicated (cheap). I can push a guide for warmup script.

Priya (AE): Great. Also they want Dedicated pricing — monthly commit + overage. Can someone prep a quick quote for mid-sized bank profile (500 customer-active sessions, 200k tokens/day)?

Marta (Solutions Eng): I can draft numbers. For 500 session baseline, recommend a small Dedicated pool (2x A10x3 equivalent) and enable persistent KV caching. Draft margin + usage estimate: will post by EOD.

Jordan (SRE): Quick note on batching conflicts: their client sends many short parallel requests which get coalesced into big batches, increasing per-request latency. Suggest client-side concurrency limit (max inflight per session = 4) and prefer streaming for UX.

Priya (AE): I'll relay both changes to Atlas dev team. Security Qs: they asked about KMS for keys, data residency, and audit logs.

Marta (Solutions Eng): Answers: we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK), Private deployment option for on-prem/VPC (data residency), and audit logs via Console with 90d retention (enterprise add-on possible). I'll attach the official blurb.

Priya (AE): Perfect. Any blocker for them to test warmup on Hosted before committing to Dedicated?

Riya (SE): No blocker. We can implement a small warmup shim at the SDK layer and enable prefix caching for their org id. I'll send a sample curl + Node snippet.

Priya (AE): Please do. Also they asked whether warmup costs are billable — we should confirm pricing impact.

Marta (Solutions Eng): Warmup traffic counts as tokens (so billed), but minimal — a 1-token warmup per session is tiny on 200k tokens/day. I'll include a cost estimate.

Jordan (SRE): Operational ask: If we enable org-level prefix caching, we'll need a short maintenance window to toggle config on infra; I can do a zero-downtime flip tonight at 23:00 PST.

Priya (AE): Atlas asked for earliest change. Can we do tonight?

Jordan (SRE): yes, ping me in #eng-oncall at 22:45 PST and I'll run the change. deploy-bot will post the toggle.

deploy-bot: scheduled: org-prefix-cache-toggle for org=atlasbank at 2026-03-10T23:00:00-07:00. CI checks passed.

Priya (AE): Awesome — I'll confirm with Atlas. Thanks everyone. I'll follow up after Atlas runs the warmup test tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

Marta (Solutions Eng): I'll DM the pricing sheet to Priya now.

Riya (SE): Uploading quick warmup snippet here:

```
# Node example
await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-medium',
  prompt: 'warmup',
  org_id: 'atlasbank',
  conversation_id: '<session-id>'
})
```

Priya (AE): Closing loop: Atlas confirmed 60% TTFT reduction after warmup on their QA env. They'll review Dedicated quote next week. Closing this thread once pricing finalized. :white_check_mark:
